initial_compile_failure.reason: Test-only macro needed an anyhow namespace; corrected.

verified: Production QueryHandler and reconnect worker drain current progress to workflows bound to the configured owner DM. Positive private-recipient metadata is checked before claim and again before send.
Durable per-workflow/destination/sequence claim pins the content, nonce and uncertainty before transport dispatch. Duplicate polls and reopened stores cannot claim an already attempted update.
Older unsent history is summarized by the current progress state. A stale pending-list sequence cannot dispatch after progress has advanced; durable historical events remain retained.
Successful transport message IDs confirm only the exact workflow, sequence and bound destination. Repeated identical receipts are idempotent and conflicting receipts reject.

An uncertain update blocks later sends at that workflow destination. Production-adapter regression sends one confirmed update, then injects a lost response and verifies repeated drains do not resend it.
Status counts unconfirmed progress across bound destinations and reports delivery-confirmed or delivery-uncertain without claiming workflow or deployment success.
limits: No live Discord acceptance, deployment, hosted CI acceptance or soak completed. No child issue closed.

This change sends append-only current updates in already-bound owner DMs. Operational destination routing, PR threads, one editable status message, routine-edit throttling and preserving a separate latest unresolved blocker summary remain open.

All transport failures remain conservatively uncertain. Typed 429/backoff handling, degraded/dead-letter states, bounded history reconciliation and explicit owner resolution/duplicate-authorized retry remain open.
Destination generation/rebind, legacy notification deduplication, actual provider receipt projection and verified updater deployment outcomes remain open.
